scripts.image:build: pnpm build:control && docker build -t witness-computer:dev infra/computer
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/renderer/remotion/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build:control: esbuild packages/computer/src/server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:playwright-core --log-level=warning --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=infra/computer/control/dist/control.mjs
